test_title: PYST 3: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 20 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the correct homophone:

In the dense forest, a mother _______ and her cubs roamed freely, enjoying the tranquillity of their natural habitat.
solution:
The correct answer is: **bear.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"bear"** means a large, heavy mammal with thick fur and a very short tail. (भालू)

 
 
• **Example: **The bear hibernates during the winter months in its den.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that a mother bear and her cubs were enjoying the peace and quiet of their natural home as they wandered freely through the lush woodland.
